news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹15.09 (up from ₹8.50 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹23.8b (up 66% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹1.70b (up 82% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.1% (up from 6.5% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 6.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 7.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.1% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 13% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 4% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd (NSEI:ANURAS) proposed to acquire 26.21% stake in Bliss GVS Pharma Limited (BSE:506197) for INR 8.3 billion.
news.body:
Anupam Rasayan India Ltd (NSEI:ANURAS) proposed to acquire 26.21% stake in Bliss GVS Pharma Limited (BSE:506197) for INR 8.3 billion on May 23, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 8.29 billion valued at INR 299 per share will be paid by Anupam Rasayan India Ltd. As part of consideration, INR 8.29 billion is paid towards common equity of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited. In a related transaction, Anupam Rasayan India Ltd will acquire stake in Bliss GVS Pharma Limited through a share purchase agreement.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by acquirer board and subject to statutory approval. The deal has been approved by the board of Anupam Rasayan India Ltd.

SBI Capital Markets Limited acted as Manager to the Open Offer for Anupam Rasayan India Ltd.

news.title: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd (NSEI:ANURAS) completed the acquisition of Jayhawk Fine Chemicals Corporation from CABB Group GmbH.
news.body:
Anupam Rasayan India Ltd (NSEI:ANURAS) entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Jayhawk Fine Chemicals Corporation from CABB Group GmbH for approximately $150 million on December 9, 2025. The purchase consideration of approximately $150 million includes approximately $16 million of cash and cash-like items for Jayhawk as of June 2025 and existing loans payable to the existing shareholders. The acquisition will be financed through a mix of internal accruals, debt and quasi equity. 

For the period ending December 31, 2024, Jayhawk Fine Chemicals Corporation reported a revenue of $78.3 million and EBITDA of approximately $15 million.
